# Figure captions (generated by make_figures.py — do not edit by hand)

**F1_g0_calibration.** Harness calibration on identical data (165,437 M5 bars) and identical strategy code; the two runs differ only in the window-slicing rule. (a) The hatched bar is the legacy per-leg statistic; moving to the per-signal unit and then to close-time slicing reduces t from +3.345 to +2.453 to +0.917. (b) Per-signal expectancy with a 95% interval recovered from the reported t (SE = mean/t). Limit-fill configuration, costs on.
*Source:* report_calib_v1_full.json (SHA-256 611cf0bbc7003970…); report_calib_v2_full.json (SHA-256 c71ed4c181c1f610…).

**F2_g0_equity.** Cumulative return (top) and drawdown from running peak (bottom) for the two calibration runs in Fig. F1, as percentages of the simulated starting balance, sampled at each day's last bar. Daily sampling understates the intrabar maximum drawdown reported by the backtester (legacy 4.82%, harness-v2 5.43%). Return falls under the corrected harness while maximum drawdown does not.
*Source:* report_calib_v1_full.json (SHA-256 611cf0bbc7003970…); report_calib_v2_full.json (SHA-256 c71ed4c181c1f610…).

**F3_forming_bar.** Share of 1000 random M5 decision steps at which the H1 window contained a bar that had not yet closed. Legacy slicing: 915/1000; theoretical rate for M5 steps within an hour: 55/60; harness-v2: 0/1000 (mandatory test, fixed seed, re-run 2026-11-01).
*Source:* paper/figures/data/test_no_lookahead_run_2026-11-01.txt (SHA-256 8665c4f57915bc68…); tests/test_no_lookahead.py (SHA-256 875305ae0c521f07…).

**F4_zone_dev.** Pre-registered supply/demand-zone strategy on the DEV partition (2024). T1 is the frozen specification; T2–T4 vary the two zone-quality parameters (all four runs are rows 1–4 of the append-only trial ledger). Points are per-signal expectancy net of costs; bars are 95% intervals recovered from the reported t (SE = mean/t). The dashed line is the pre-registered gate. T1 t = −2.793. Every point estimate is negative and every interval lies below the gate.
*Source:* report_zone_dev_t1.json (SHA-256 8e78f735b0f4b135…); report_zone_dev_t2.json (SHA-256 680cfa7bc39d4ac3…); report_zone_dev_t3.json (SHA-256 cabb08e7febc8bc5…); report_zone_dev_t4.json (SHA-256 3b6de201b05e0ac0…); trials.csv (SHA-256 8334fec3d4328530…); specs/phase1_zone_spec_v1.md (SHA-256 03ddb7b216a925c0…).

**F5_zone_funnel.** Signal funnel for the frozen zone specification on DEV. Touches not traded: 74 skipped by the one-position limit and 28 by the gap-through-stop rule.
*Source:* report_zone_dev_t1.json (SHA-256 8e78f735b0f4b135…).

**F6_idea_register.** The 15 documented ideas and their epistemic labels (Table 3). Tiles marked † (dashed border) rest on a dated contemporaneous record whose generating script was not re-run (Tier B). ¹Premium present but tail risk incompatible with a 10% drawdown cap. ²Phase-1 gate passed; no significant alpha beyond a buyable managed-futures ETF. 'Not supported' means no evidence of edge, not evidence of no edge. Per-idea sources are listed by claim ID in the claims table.
*Source:* paper/claims.csv (SHA-256 3deb8b61a7ee262f…).

**F7_power_band.** Why the re-measurement is weak evidence. Per-signal t for the ≥2-timing-flag SMC subset: in-sample (subset chosen after seeing these data) t = +3.045, n = 228; re-run windows t = +0.06, n = 37. The re-run windows lie inside the in-sample period and are not an out-of-sample test. The band shows the t expected at each n if the in-sample per-signal Sharpe (0.202) were true; the re-measurement falls inside it. Both sides ran on the legacy harness.
*Source:* report_full.json (SHA-256 a7fedee66dc7badc…); report_w1.json (SHA-256 8c76ed83a99772f3…); report_w2.json (SHA-256 476833c1c1aa009c…); report_w3.json (SHA-256 cd33449fc8eec236…); report_w4.json (SHA-256 a849526720e1a6c8…); report_w5.json (SHA-256 ecfc8198f9d91cf1…).

**F8_architecture.** Runtime architecture, drawn from the publish/subscribe calls in the code (event-bus topic names in monospace). Both halt paths (reconciliation desync in the trade logger; unconfirmed fill in the order executor) raise SYSTEM_SHUTDOWN, which stops trading without closing positions. The decision path from bars to orders is deterministic; the optional language-model component is an hourly higher-timeframe advisory that is disabled by default. Secondary components (break-even monitor, pending-order manager, notifier, status exporter, system monitor, emergency liquidator) are omitted for legibility.
*Source:* main.py (SHA-256 a01eb656a6ec7efd…); core/event_bus.py (SHA-256 9d08645d45403b69…); agents/risk_manager.py (SHA-256 1dfa09df59084abe…); execution/order_executor.py (SHA-256 f3fdfe9f9b680891…); memory/trade_logger.py (SHA-256 1688bb607d715397…).

**F9_preregistration_timeline.** Order of events in the zone study, from git commit timestamps and the trial ledger's own timestamps (UTC; gaps between consecutive events on the left). The specification (prior, gate G2, partitions) was committed 21.4 h before the first ledger row was written. Ledger timestamps record when a run completed; start times were not recorded, so the first run may have begun shortly before the engine commit. The spec's own provenance appendix states that no statistic was computed on any partition before the freeze. The only later spec change was that provenance appendix (40 lines added, 0 deleted). Rows 2–4 were chosen after row 1 under the spec's DEV-tuning allowance. Commit times are self-reported by the author's machine and are not externally notarised.
*Source:* paper/figures/data/git_timeline_utc.txt (SHA-256 94bca4ed34c7db10…); trials.csv (SHA-256 8334fec3d4328530…); specs/phase1_zone_spec_v1.md (SHA-256 03ddb7b216a925c0…); paper/figures/data/spec_appendix_numstat_8634f34.txt (SHA-256 4f2bfe6ee91d7c32…).
